edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against feeToSetter to authorize setFeeTo.
msg.sender is compared against feeToSetter to authorize setFeeToSetter.
msg.sender must equal factory for initialize to succeed.
pair_factory state variable is the authorization source checked in initialize.
Any msg.sender can invoke pair SaveLostTokens which drains funds with no authorization check.
Any msg.sender can invoke factory SaveLostTokens which drains funds with no authorization check.
permit requires deadline >= block.timestamp, making the check timestamp dependent.
_update derives timeElapsed from block.timestamp for price accumulators, a timestamp dependency.
Caller-controlled token parameter flows directly into the unauthenticated IERC20 transfer.
Hardcoded owner local variable is the destination of the drained token transfer.
Hardcoded owner local variable is the recipient of the drained ETH transfer.
swap performs an external DOJOSWAPCall to a caller-supplied contract before reserves are updated.
amount0Out parameter influences the optimistic transfer and subsequent callback.
unlocked lock flag guards swap against reentrant entry.
_safeTransfer performs a low-level call to an arbitrary token address.
burn invokes _safeTransfer to move underlying tokens.
skim invokes _safeTransfer to move excess tokens.
swap invokes _safeTransfer to send output tokens.
createPair calls initialize on the newly deployed pair.
permit passes the computed digest into ecrecover.
to parameter is the recipient used inside swap.
deadline parameter of permit is compared against block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: The hardcoded owner local variable is only used as the destination of the unauthenticated token drain.
The token parameter is only consumed by the unauthenticated IERC20 transfer in SaveLostTokens.
The recipient parameter is only used within swap's output transfers.
The output amount parameter directly controls swap's optimistic transfer logic.
The deadline parameter is only compared against block.timestamp inside permit.
